name: Champlain Metals
old_description: Champlain Metals offers design and metal fabrication solutions for structural and ornamental metal work. John Marius carries on the old world passion for detail rooted in the traditions learned from working in the New York metropolitan area and the Champagne and Alsatian regions of France.
about:
Champlain Metals was founded in 2004 by John Marius in Burlington, Vermont. Marius, who trained with the French artisans' guild Compagnons du Devoir, brought metalworking traditions from the Champagne and Alsatian regions of France and the New York metropolitan area to the Champlain Valley.

The shop provides design, custom fabrication, casting, and forging for structural and ornamental metalwork. Its output ranges from architectural elements such as stair stringers, bronze cap rails, and awning brackets to finished goods like garden trowels, side tables, and heat exchangers. The facility handles both one-off commissions and production runs, though specific capacity figures are not disclosed.

Clients include contractors, architects, and private customers throughout the Champlain Valley and beyond. Project examples cited on the company's site include stair stringers for a contractor named Andrew Russel, a heat exchanger for a residential client, and forged bronze brackets for architectural installations.

Marius emphasizes an old-world passion for detail rooted in his guild training and European experience, positioning the company as a keeper of traditional metalworking methods while serving modern structural and decorative needs.
